title: Mol language
description: Torricelli language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Amol, also Alatil or Aru, is a Torricelli language of Papua New Guinea. The names Amol and Aru are both slightly erroneous. Speakers of the language call their language Mol, while speakers of surrounding languages call the language Oru. Matthew S. Dryer of the University at Buffalo has collected data on Mol.
